sources.note: Bibliography lists only Panda 2012, Nyst 2014 (classification), Woodward 2012 p.c., Campbell et al. 2022 (endangerment); zero grammar/phonology descriptions (Glottolog lists no grammar, sketch or phonology).

Nothing on structure beyond numerals (additive/subtractive numeral strategies, mouth movements for large numbers); cites Panda 2012 and Zeshan et al. 2016 (numerals in rural sign languages, De Gruyter).
